alternatives.argument: The item is a definition, not an imported theorem. It defines the common macro grid, partial deterministic maps, sequential fine/coarse trajectories, explicit-RK composition, and selected backward-Euler root branch directly. The referenced supplier bodies specify the RK stage map and BE equation, while the item states failure on unavailable evaluations and imports no accuracy, uniqueness, stability, or convergence result.

The exact algorithm is completely specified locally: coarse initialization is serial; each sweep evaluates the fine maps on the previous row, then updates in increasing n by U_{n+1}^{k+1}=G_n(U_n^{k+1})+F_n(U_n^k)-G_n(U_n^k). The proof-independent procedure also specifies failure/budget returns and labels its work/span expression as a model, not a speedup theorem.

The local proof sets e_n^k=U_n^k-x_n and derives E_{n+1}^{k+1}<=aE_n^{k+1}+bE_n^k from the update and the two Lipschitz bounds. With A=max(1,a), induction on n and Pascal’s identity yield E_n^k<=M binom(n,k) A^n b^k. For fixed T=NH, A^N<=exp(C_a T) and binom(N,k)<=N^k, so b<=C_b H^(q+1) gives M(C_bT)^k exp(C_aT)H^(qk). All comparisons are explicitly restricted to D; no generic convergence conclusion is imported.

full_text_read.method: Complete 27-page author-hosted PDF fetched and inspected locally; all of §§2.1–2.4 and §4.5 were read in full.
full_text_read.scope: All-at-once formulation, reduction and ideal transfers, MGRIT F/FCF cycle, multilevel V-cycle, and cost-model assumptions.

retrieval_history.initial_attempt: Direct full-text fetch succeeded; the document was confirmed as a 27-page PDF.
alternative_searches: Compared the all-at-once and F/FCF descriptions with Gander’s full Chapter 4 lecture notes and Dobrev et al.’s two-grid analysis.

sources.title: V. A. Dobrev, Tz. Kolev, N. A. Petersson, and J. B. Schroder, “Two-Level Convergence Theory for Multigrid Reduction in Time (MGRIT),” author preprint
sources.locator: Complete 43-page author-hosted PDF. Relevant sections: §2, §3.1–3.2, PDF pp. 4–10, Theorem 3.3 and its proof; conclusion, PDF p. 26.
sources.support: Independent two-grid MGRIT convergence analysis. Its explicit spectral bound assumes simultaneous unitary diagonalization and stable fine/coarse propagators; the local theorem imports none of that restricted estimate.

contents.name: Scalar two-grid MGRIT matrix context
contents.support: The source gives an independent two-level error-matrix framework; the local scalar coefficients and exact induced norm are recomputed directly, and the source theorem’s extra diagonalization hypotheses are not imported.

full_text_read.method: Complete 43-page author-hosted preprint fetched and text-extracted locally. The full algorithm section, error-propagation derivation, Theorem 3.3 proof, and conclusion were inspected.
full_text_read.scope: §2, §3.1–3.2, Theorem 3.3, and §5 conclusion; model-specific numerical experiments were treated as illustrations only.
